fundamental.name: Xtranet Technologies Ltd
pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 37.6%
Debtor days have improved from 162 to 114 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend

current_ratio.note: 1.31x (Mar 2026): adequate but thin buffer — from the the data provider balance sheet

signal.label: BUY
signal.disclaimer: Rules-based screen for research/education only — not personalized investment advice. Verify independently before any decision.

bias_check.principle: Markets price expectations, not your conviction — weigh valuation, the macro and the data, not just the story.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

strengths.point: Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital.
Shareholder capital is compounding at a high rate.

strengths.evidence: Results score 95/100 - Sales +139% YoY; strong sales growth; Net profit +367% YoY
Fundamental score 85/100 - multi-year sales uptrend; multi-year profit uptrend; rising EPS trend
Technical score 100/100 - RS rating 100 (market-beating); +49% vs Nifty 500 (3M)

strengths.point: Net profit is growing fast year on year.
Operating margin has widened over the last few years.
Interest cost is trivial next to operating profit.
strengths.evidence: Operating profit 64 Cr vs interest 6 Cr = 10.7x cover (Mar 2026)

strengths.point: The sales trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.
The net profit trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.
strengths.evidence: Net Profit trend (yearly): Increasing for 4 years

strengths.point: The eps trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.
The reserves trend has been rising for 5 years in a row.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
Borrowings have climbed sharply over the last few years.
Only part of the reported profit turns into operating cash.
P/E is expensive against the sector median.
Receivables days are on the higher side.
Inventory days are on the higher side.
Earnings follow a seasonal cycle rather than a steady line.

weaknesses.evidence: Signal flag: trades below DCF value

weaknesses.point: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend.
weaknesses.evidence: Flagged as a negative: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend

opportunities.point: The management's ambition is to surpass its original revenue guidance while sustaining strong EBITDA and PAT margins.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "The momentum achieved during H1 gives us confidence in our full-year performance, and our ambition is to surpass our original revenue guidance while sustaining strong EBITDA and PAT margins." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company is targeting revenue of over Rs. 500 crores for FY27, representing a growth of approximately 35% to 40%.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Yes, so here targeting the FY26, we closed at Rs. 365 crore and we are targeting 500 plus crores for FY27. Approximately 35 to 40% of the growth." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The company formed a dedicated subsidiary focused on developing and operating data center infrastructure.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "An important strategic development during the quarter was the formation of Xtranet Data Center, a dedicated subsidiary focused on developing and operating data center infrastructure." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Initially, the company is planning to start a 2MW data center with an expansion capacity of around 10MW.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "We have created a subsidiary because it is an asset-intensive business and initially we are planning to start with the 2MW with the expansion capacity of around 10MW." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The shares trade under the model's intrinsic value.
opportunities.evidence: DCF intrinsic 319 vs price 262 - margin of safety 18%

opportunities.point: India's installed data center capacity is expected to increase nearly fivefold to approximately 7.5 gigawatts by March 2030.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "India's installed data center capacity is expected to increase nearly fivefold to approximately 7.5 gigawatts by March 2030, supported by the investment of more than INR 3 lakh crores over the next four, five financial years." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Revenue growth for Indian IT service companies is projected at 3% to 5% in FY’27.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Revenue growth for Indian IT service companies is projected at 3% to 5% in FY’27." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: During Q2 FY’27, the company secured fresh orders of approximately Rs. 90 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "During Q2 FY’27, we secured fresh order of approximately Rs. 90 crores, taking our order book to around Rs. 390 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The bid pipeline remained strong at over Rs. 2,000 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Our bid pipeline also remained strong at over Rs. 2,000 crores, providing opportunities to further expand our business." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The revenue contribution from international proposals will start from the fourth quarter of the financial year.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Sukhbir Singh Kukreja: The revenue contribution will start hopefully from the Q4 of this financial year." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01) [FY27]

opportunities.point: International expansion remains a strategic priority for exploring overseas business opportunities and technology partnerships.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "International expansion remains a strategic priority, with the company exploring overseas business opportunities, technology partnerships and collaborations to diversify its geographical revenue base." (concall ppt - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company aims to keep the data center portion at 50% of overall revenue and target 35% to 40% annual growth in this segment.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, data center portion, we want to keep it at 50% of the overall revenue and year on year, we are expanding. We are looking forward to 35% to 40% of the annual growth in this segment from our business perspective." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Securing timely availability of hardware and software and protecting margins against supply disruption temporarily increased working capital requirements.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "While this has temporarily increased our working capital requirements, we believe these investments will support stronger execution, revenue growth, and profitability during H2 FY’27." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: The cost of hardware has moved almost 3x to 4x in size over the last year.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The cost of hardware has moved almost 3x-4x size basically." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Procuring products has become a little bit of a challenge besides high prices.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "But till now, on our company side, we have not faced any kind of a cancellation or anything. We are very strategically working on wherein we can fulfil the requirement of the customer end-to-end and we are trying to cope up as of now." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S30/W15/O28/T14), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 57 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
